question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) as delivery_date,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))::INTEGER as month_num,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))::INTEGER as year_num
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
),
month_list AS (
    SELECT 1 as month_num, 'January' as month_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'February'
    UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'March'
    UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'April'
    UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'May'
    UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'June'
    UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'July'
    UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'August'
    UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'September'
    UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'October'
    UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'November'
    UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'December'
)
SELECT 
    ml.month_name,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.year_num = 2016 THEN 1 END), 0)::INTEGER as "2016",
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.year_num = 2017 THEN 1 END), 0)::INTEGER as "2017",
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.year_num = 2018 THEN 1 END), 0)::INTEGER as "2018"
FROM month_list ml
LEFT JOIN delivered_orders d ON ml.month_num = d.month_num
GROUP BY ml.month_name, ml.month_num
ORDER BY ml.month_num
